provenance.title: Hadron Structure in Chiral Perturbation Theory A. Aleksejevs∗
provenance.authors: Grenfell campus of Memorial University, Newfoundland, Canada

candidates.statement: To investigate the behavior of the pion form factor experimentally at momentum transfers $Q^{2}>0.3\, GeV^{2}$ and in the transitional region between long-distance and short-distance QCD, one must use the charged pion electroproduction process.
